option.name: -a
tip: Same as -p, provided for backwards compatibility.

option.name: -b
tip: Use the alternative superblock at this location.

option.name: -B
tip: Force the superblock search to use this block size.

option.name: -c
tip: Scan the device for bad blocks with badblocks(8).
Specify twice for a non-destructive read-write test.

option.name: -C
tip: Write completion information to the file descriptor.

option.name: -d
tip: Print debugging output.

option.name: -D
tip: Optimize all directories in the file system.

option.name: -E
tip: Set comma-separated e2fsck extended options.
See e2fsck(8) for the supported options.

option.name: -f
tip: Force checking even if the file system seems clean.

option.name: -F
tip: Flush the device buffer caches before starting.

option.name: -j
tip: Set the pathname of the external journal.

option.name: -k
tip: Preserve existing bad blocks when used with -c.

option.name: -l
tip: Add the block numbers listed in the file to the bad blocks list.

option.name: -L
tip: Set the bad blocks list to the blocks listed in the file.

option.name: -n
tip: Open the file system read-only and answer no to all questions.

option.name: -p
tip: Automatically repair the file system without questions.

option.name: -r
tip: Does nothing; provided for backwards compatibility.

option.name: -t
tip: Print timing statistics.
Specify twice for per-pass statistics.

option.name: -v
tip: Verbose mode.

option.name: -V
tip: Print version information and exit.

option.name: -y
tip: Assume yes to all questions.

option.name: -z
tip: Write the old contents of each block to an undo file.
